title: 项目协作与问题解决 · 100 句
description: 澄清需求、拆解任务、资源协调、试验、排查、选择方案、实施、验收和复盘。

items.zh: 我们还没有定义成功标准。
items.en: We have not defined success yet.
answers: We have not defined success yet.
We haven't defined success yet.

items.zh: 这个要求可以具体一点吗？
items.en: Could this requirement be more specific?
answers: Could this requirement be more specific?

items.zh: 谁是最终使用者？
items.en: Who is the end user?
answers: Who is the end user?

items.zh: 我们解决的其实是两个问题。
items.en: We are actually solving two problems.
answers: We are actually solving two problems.

items.zh: 范围中是否包含培训？
items.en: Does the scope include training?
answers: Does the scope include training?

items.zh: 这项假设还没有验证。
items.en: This assumption remains untested.
answers: This assumption remains untested.

items.zh: 我需要区分必要项和可选项。
items.en: I need to distinguish essentials from options.
answers: I need to distinguish essentials from options.

items.zh: 请说明不能改变的限制。
items.en: Please state the fixed constraints.
answers: Please state the fixed constraints.

items.zh: 这个要求与之前的决定冲突。
items.en: This requirement conflicts with an earlier decision.
answers: This requirement conflicts with an earlier decision.

items.zh: 客户要求的外观调整不属于本轮维修范围。
items.en: The cosmetic changes requested by the client fall outside this repair round.
answers: The cosmetic changes requested by the client fall outside this repair round.
items.notes: fall outside：不属于；区分外观变更和维修范围。

items.zh: 先把任务拆成较小的部分。
items.en: Break the task into smaller parts.
answers: Break the task into smaller parts.

items.zh: 这一步依赖上一步的结果。
items.en: This step depends on the previous result.
answers: This step depends on the previous result.

items.zh: 两个任务可以同时进行。
items.en: The two tasks can run in parallel.
answers: The two tasks can run in parallel.

items.zh: 我们漏掉了准备时间。
items.en: We overlooked the preparation time.
answers: We overlooked the preparation time.

items.zh: 这个部分需要专门负责人。
items.en: This part needs a designated owner.
answers: This part needs a designated owner.

items.zh: 我想先处理最不确定的环节。
items.en: I want to address the greatest uncertainty first.
answers: I want to address the greatest uncertainty first.

items.zh: 勾完清单并不能证明工作已经完成。
items.en: Ticking every box on a checklist does not prove that the work is complete.
answers: Ticking every box on a checklist does not prove that the work is complete.
Ticking every box on a checklist doesn't prove that the work is complete.
items.notes: tick a box：勾选；区分手续记录和实际完成。

items.zh: 这项工作无法平均分配。
items.en: This work cannot be divided evenly.
answers: This work cannot be divided evenly.
This work can't be divided evenly.

items.zh: 我们需要明确交接点。
items.en: We need clear handover points.
answers: We need clear handover points.

items.zh: 小任务也有自己的截止时间。
items.en: Small tasks have deadlines of their own.
answers: Small tasks have deadlines of their own.

items.zh: 我的估算包括实际操作时间，不包括等待审批的时间。
items.en: My estimate covers hands-on work but excludes time spent waiting for approval.
answers: My estimate covers hands-on work but excludes time spent waiting for approval.

items.zh: 审批会成为瓶颈。
items.en: Approval will be a bottleneck.
answers: Approval will be a bottleneck.

items.zh: 设备只有上午可以使用。
items.en: The equipment is available only in the morning.
answers: The equipment is available only in the morning.

items.zh: 我们需要给意外留余量。
items.en: We need a margin for the unexpected.
answers: We need a margin for the unexpected.

items.zh: 增加人手不一定能加快每个阶段。
items.en: Extra staff do not necessarily speed up every stage.
answers: Extra staff do not necessarily speed up every stage.
Extra staff don't necessarily speed up every stage.

items.zh: 这个日期取决于材料到货。
items.en: The date depends on material delivery.
answers: The date depends on material delivery.

items.zh: 必须把维护时间算进去。
items.en: Maintenance time must be included.
answers: Maintenance time must be included.

items.zh: 我不能同时承诺这两项任务。
items.en: I cannot commit to both tasks simultaneously.
answers: I cannot commit to both tasks simultaneously.
I can't commit to both tasks simultaneously.

items.zh: 新的优先级会影响其他工作。
items.en: The new priority will affect other work.
answers: The new priority will affect other work.

items.zh: 我们应把预测与承诺区分开。
items.en: We should separate forecasts from commitments.
answers: We should separate forecasts from commitments.

items.zh: 先测试最简单的版本。
items.en: Test the simplest version first.
answers: Test the simplest version first.

items.zh: 这只是验证概念的样品。
items.en: This sample only tests the concept.
answers: This sample only tests the concept.

items.zh: 我们需要记录失败条件。
items.en: We need to record the failure conditions.
answers: We need to record the failure conditions.

items.zh: 一次只改变一个关键因素。
items.en: Change one key factor at a time.
answers: Change one key factor at a time.

items.zh: 对照版本应保持不变。
items.en: The comparison version should remain unchanged.
answers: The comparison version should remain unchanged.

items.zh: 测试环境与实际使用不同。
items.en: The test environment differs from real use.
answers: The test environment differs from real use.

items.zh: 结果不符合我们的预期。
items.en: The result contradicts our expectations.
answers: The result contradicts our expectations.

items.zh: 这个问题只在重负载下出现。
items.en: This issue occurs only under heavy load.
answers: This issue occurs only under heavy load.

items.zh: 我们需要复现这个现象。
items.en: We need to reproduce this behaviour.
answers: We need to reproduce this behaviour.

items.zh: 先确认测试方法没有问题。
items.en: First establish that the test is valid.
answers: First establish that the test is valid.

items.zh: 故障是间歇性的。
items.en: The fault is intermittent.
answers: The fault is intermittent.

items.zh: 我们不知道变化从哪里开始。
items.en: We do not know where the change began.
answers: We do not know where the change began.
We don't know where the change began.

items.zh: 这两个事件发生时间相近。
items.en: These events occurred close together in time.
answers: These events occurred close together in time.

items.zh: 相邻发生不证明存在因果。
items.en: Closeness in time does not prove causation.
answers: Closeness in time does not prove causation.
Closeness in time doesn't prove causation.

items.zh: 先排除最容易检查的原因。
items.en: Rule out the easiest causes to check first.
answers: Rule out the easiest causes to check first.

items.zh: 重启消除了故障表现，但没有揭示根本原因。
items.en: Restarting cleared the symptom but did not reveal the underlying cause.
answers: Restarting cleared the symptom but did not reveal the underlying cause.
Restarting cleared the symptom but didn't reveal the underlying cause.
items.notes: clear the symptom：消除故障表现；reveal：揭示。

items.zh: 日志只保留了最后一分钟。
items.en: The log retains only the final minute.
answers: The log retains only the final minute.

items.zh: 我想了解失败前的操作顺序。
items.en: I want the sequence of actions before failure.
answers: I want the sequence of actions before failure.

items.zh: 这个解释无法涵盖所有情况。
items.en: This explanation does not cover every case.
answers: This explanation does not cover every case.
This explanation doesn't cover every case.

items.zh: 我们发现每次故障都伴随着同一个条件。
items.en: We found a condition shared by every failure.
answers: We found a condition shared by every failure.
items.notes: shared by every failure：所有故障共有的。

items.zh: 方案甲更快，但后期维护更难。
items.en: Option A is faster but harder to maintain.
answers: Option A is faster but harder to maintain.

items.zh: 临时修复可以争取时间。
items.en: A temporary fix can buy us time.
answers: A temporary fix can buy us time.

items.zh: 这个方案把成本推到了以后。
items.en: This solution defers costs until later.
answers: This solution defers costs until later.

items.zh: 我们需要比较总工作量。
items.en: We need to compare total effort.
answers: We need to compare total effort.

items.zh: 可逆的决定可以先小范围试行。
items.en: Reversible decisions can be trialled on a small scale.
answers: Reversible decisions can be trialled on a small scale.

items.zh: 对单一供应商的依赖是个缺点。
items.en: Dependence on one supplier is a drawback.
answers: Dependence on one supplier is a drawback.

items.zh: 最便宜的选项不满足关键要求。
items.en: The cheapest option fails a key requirement.
answers: The cheapest option fails a key requirement.

items.zh: 我们可以组合两个方案的优点。
items.en: We can combine strengths from both approaches.
answers: We can combine strengths from both approaches.

items.zh: 这个取舍需要明确记录。
items.en: This trade-off needs explicit documentation.
answers: This trade-off needs explicit documentation.

items.zh: 暂时不采取行动也是一个选项。
items.en: Taking no action for now is also an option.
answers: Taking no action for now is also an option.

items.zh: 先通知受影响的人。
items.en: Notify affected people first.
answers: Notify affected people first.

items.zh: 变更应在低峰时段进行。
items.en: The change should happen during quieter hours.
answers: The change should happen during quieter hours.

items.zh: 我们需要能够退回旧版本。
items.en: We need a way to restore the old version.
answers: We need a way to restore the old version.

items.zh: 实施负责人和验收负责人不同。
items.en: Implementation and acceptance have different owners.
answers: Implementation and acceptance have different owners.

items.zh: 这一步不能跳过。
items.en: This step cannot be skipped.
answers: This step cannot be skipped.
This step can't be skipped.

items.zh: 先检查材料是否齐全。
items.en: Check that all materials are present first.
answers: Check that all materials are present first.

items.zh: 我会逐项记录实际进度。
items.en: I will record actual progress item by item.
answers: I will record actual progress item by item.

items.zh: 异常情况需要立即上报。
items.en: Exceptions need to be reported promptly.
answers: Exceptions need to be reported promptly.

items.zh: 我们还没有进入最后阶段。
items.en: We have not reached the final stage.
answers: We have not reached the final stage.
We haven't reached the final stage.

items.zh: 完成后检查关联功能。
items.en: Check related functions afterwards.
answers: Check related functions afterwards.

items.zh: 更新应说明发生了什么变化。
items.en: An update should explain what changed.
answers: An update should explain what changed.

items.zh: 别只报告百分比。
items.en: Report more than a percentage.
answers: Report more than a percentage.

items.zh: 我需要一个可以采取行动的结论。
items.en: I need an actionable conclusion.
answers: I need an actionable conclusion.

items.zh: 这个风险由谁决定接受？
items.en: Who decides whether this risk is acceptable?
answers: Who decides whether this risk is acceptable?

items.zh: 我们意见不同，但目标一致。
items.en: We disagree, but our objective is shared.
answers: We disagree, but our objective is shared.

items.zh: 请把问题和建议分开列出。
items.en: Please list the issue separately from the recommendation.
answers: Please list the issue separately from the recommendation.

items.zh: 我想核对我们是否理解一致。
items.en: I want to check our shared understanding.
answers: I want to check our shared understanding.

items.zh: 需要把这项决定告知下游团队。
items.en: The downstream team needs to be informed of this decision.
answers: The downstream team needs to be informed of this decision.
items.notes: be informed of：获知；downstream：下游环节。

items.zh: 没有消息不代表没有阻碍。
items.en: Silence does not mean there are no obstacles.
answers: Silence does not mean there are no obstacles.
Silence doesn't mean there are no obstacles.

items.zh: 请注明哪些信息还不确定。
items.en: Please mark the information that remains uncertain.
answers: Please mark the information that remains uncertain.

items.zh: 验收测试必须使用实际样本。
items.en: Acceptance testing must use real samples.
answers: Acceptance testing must use real samples.

items.zh: 我们需要验证边界情况。
items.en: We need to verify edge cases.
answers: We need to verify edge cases.

items.zh: 文档也属于交付物。
items.en: Documentation is also a deliverable.
answers: Documentation is also a deliverable.

items.zh: 这个缺陷是否影响主要用途？
items.en: Does this defect affect the primary use?
answers: Does this defect affect the primary use?

items.zh: 我想保留双方签署的验收记录。
items.en: I want to retain an acceptance record signed by both parties.
answers: I want to retain an acceptance record signed by both parties.
items.notes: signed by 限定验收记录；验收不同于收货。

items.zh: 完成标准不应临时改变。
items.en: Completion criteria should not change at the last minute.
answers: Completion criteria should not change at the last minute.
Completion criteria shouldn't change at the last minute.

items.zh: 我们不能只测试顺利的路径。
items.en: We cannot test only the happy path.
answers: We cannot test only the happy path.
We can't test only the happy path.

items.zh: 培训结束不等于用户已经掌握。
items.en: Completed training does not establish user competence.
answers: Completed training does not establish user competence.
Completed training doesn't establish user competence.

items.zh: 遗留问题需要单独追踪。
items.en: Remaining issues need separate tracking.
answers: Remaining issues need separate tracking.

items.zh: 正式结束前确认支持渠道。
items.en: Confirm support arrangements before formal closure.
answers: Confirm support arrangements before formal closure.

items.zh: 这次延误暴露了依赖关系。
items.en: The delay exposed a dependency.
answers: The delay exposed a dependency.

items.zh: 我们低估了沟通成本。
items.en: We underestimated the cost of coordination.
answers: We underestimated the cost of coordination.

items.zh: 顺利完成也值得分析原因。
items.en: Success also deserves examination.
answers: Success also deserves examination.

items.zh: 复盘不是寻找替罪羊。
items.en: A review is not a search for scapegoats.
answers: A review is not a search for scapegoats.
A review isn't a search for scapegoats.

items.zh: 我想知道哪项假设最脆弱。
items.en: I want to identify the weakest assumption.
answers: I want to identify the weakest assumption.

items.zh: 教训应转化为具体改变。
items.en: Lessons should lead to concrete changes.
answers: Lessons should lead to concrete changes.

items.zh: 这个办法只适用于当时条件。
items.en: That method suited those conditions only.
answers: That method suited those conditions only.

items.zh: 我们需要保留失败尝试的记录。
items.en: We need records of unsuccessful attempts.
answers: We need records of unsuccessful attempts.

items.zh: 下次先明确接口。
items.en: Next time, define the interfaces first.
answers: Next time, define the interfaces first.

items.zh: 改进也需要验证效果。
items.en: Improvements need evidence of effectiveness too.
answers: Improvements need evidence of effectiveness too.
